en.name: Ketchup, cocktail or chilli sauce
en.summary: These are the thick tomato-and-vinegar table sauces: ketchup, the horseradish-spiked cocktail sauce served with prawns, and American-style chilli sauce. Unopened they keep about 1 year from purchase in the cupboard. After opening, refrigeration gives about 6 months — and the label's advice is about quality, not safety: a shelf-stable commercial bottle is safe at room temperature once opened.
en.pantry: About 1 year from purchase, unopened, somewhere cool and dry. After opening, the room-temperature question is settled: shelf-stable commercial ketchup, cocktail sauce and chilli sauce are safe when stored at room temperature after opening, and quality rather than safety is why the labels suggest refrigerating them. Refrigeration simply ensures that commercial sauces and condiments stay fresh for a longer period of time. Ketchup is the most robust of the three — heavily acidic, salty and sugary, which is exactly why a bottle can live on a diner table all day. Left in a warm cupboard it shifts from bright red towards brick and loses its fresh tomato note, which is a loss of quality and not a hazard.
en.fridge: About 6 months at 4 °C (40 °F) or below for an opened bottle. Cocktail sauce is the one that most repays chilling, and not because of the tomato: its heat comes from horseradish, whose pungency is a volatile compound that escapes a little every time the bottle is opened and fades faster in the warm. An old cocktail sauce does not so much spoil as go quietly flat and sweet. The watery squirt that comes first out of a squeeze bottle is separation rather than spoilage — liquid has migrated out of the pulp — so shake it, and stand a squeeze bottle cap-down so you are not doing that at the table. Wipe the thread of the cap, where dried sauce gives mould somewhere to start.
en.freezer: No freezer figure is given for these sauces, and there is no real reason to freeze one that keeps for months. Freezing splits a tomato sauce into a watery layer and a pulpy one, and whisking it back together is never quite convincing. A large batch of homemade cocktail or chilli sauce is worth portioning and freezing; a commercial bottle is already covered by the cupboard and the fridge.
spoilage: Mould around the neck, the cap thread or on the surface of the sauce
A fermented, yeasty or alcoholic smell
A bottle that fizzes, hisses or squirts when opened after storage
Colour gone dark brown with a watery layer that will not shake back in
tips: Wipe the neck and the inside of the cap after every use.
Write the opening date on the label.
Keep bottles out of direct sunlight; light browns a red sauce quickly.
Never pour sauce that has been on a plate or brushed onto raw food back into the bottle.

faq.q: Does ketchup need to be refrigerated after opening?
faq.a: Not for safety — a shelf-stable commercial bottle is safe at room temperature after opening. Refrigeration keeps it fresher for longer, which is why the label suggests it.

faq.q: How long does ketchup last in the fridge?
faq.a: About 6 months after opening at 4 °C or below.

faq.q: How long does an unopened bottle keep?
faq.a: About 1 year from purchase in a cool, dry cupboard.

faq.q: Why has my ketchup gone dark?
faq.a: Tomato pigments oxidise with time, light and warmth. It is a quality change; mould, fizzing or a yeasty smell are the real warning signs.

zh.name: 番茄醬與雞尾酒醬
zh.summary: 這一類是濃稠的番茄加醋餐桌醬：番茄醬、配蝦子吃並加了辣根的雞尾酒醬，以及美式辣番茄醬。未開封放櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 1 年。開封後冷藏大約 6 個月——而標籤的建議講的是品質不是安全：常溫販售的市售瓶裝，開封後放室溫仍然安全。
zh.pantry: 未開封放陰涼乾燥處，從購買日起算大約 1 年。開封之後的室溫問題其實早有定論：常溫販售的市售番茄醬、雞尾酒醬和美式辣番茄醬，開封後放室溫仍然安全，標籤建議冷藏的理由是品質而不是安全。冷藏只是讓市售醬料的新鮮度維持得更久。三者之中番茄醬最耐放——又酸、又鹹、又甜，這正是一瓶番茄醬可以在餐廳桌上待一整天的原因。放在溫暖櫥櫃裡，它會從鮮紅轉向磚紅，失去新鮮番茄那股明亮，那是品質的損失，不是危險。
zh.fridge: 開封後放 4 °C 以下大約 6 個月。三者裡最值得冷藏的是雞尾酒醬，而原因不在番茄：它的嗆辣來自辣根，那股嗆是揮發性成分，每開一次瓶就跑掉一些，天氣一熱跑得更快。放久的雞尾酒醬與其說是壞掉，不如說是安靜地變平、變甜。擠壓瓶第一下擠出來的那股水是分離而不是變質——水分從果肉裡跑了出來——搖一搖就好；平常把擠壓瓶倒著放，就不必在餐桌上甩半天。瓶蓋螺紋也要擦乾淨，乾掉的醬垢會給黴菌一個起點。
zh.freezer: 這類醬料沒有提供冷凍期限，而且一個冷藏就能放好幾個月的東西，實在沒有冷凍的理由。冷凍會讓番茄醬分成水層和果肉層，再怎麼攪也攪不回原本的樣子。自己做了一大批雞尾酒醬或辣番茄醬，分裝冷凍很值得；市售瓶裝則有櫥櫃和冰箱就夠了。
spoilage: 瓶口、瓶蓋螺紋或醬面長霉
聞起來有發酵味、酵母味或酒味
放過一陣子後開瓶時冒氣、嘶聲或噴出
顏色轉成深褐，並分離出搖不回去的水層
tips: 每次用完都擦瓶口和瓶蓋內側。
避免陽光直射；光會讓紅醬很快變褐。
盤子上用過的、或刷過生食的醬，絕對不要倒回瓶子。

faq.q: 番茄醬開封後一定要冰嗎？
faq.a: 以安全來說不用——常溫販售的市售瓶裝開封後放室溫仍然安全。冷藏是為了維持新鮮更久，所以標籤才會建議。

faq.q: 番茄醬放冰箱可以放多久？
faq.a: 開封後在 4 °C 以下冷藏大約 6 個月。

faq.q: 未開封的番茄醬可以放多久？
faq.a: 陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 1 年。

faq.q: 番茄醬為什麼變深色了？
faq.a: 番茄色素會隨時間、光線和溫度氧化。那是品質變化；長霉、冒氣或酵母味才是真正的警訊。
